observations: Photo 0: A semi-industrial sewing machine setup on a white table with multiple thread cones on a tall stand; wall-mounted accessory shelves; power cable visible on floor.
Photo 1: Front/side view shows the machine head and a control/pedal area; several thread spools on the stand; accessories on the table and floor clutter.
Photo 2: Side view of the machine head; a large circular handwheel/cover area visible; accessories/parts laid on the table; window light in background.
Photo 3: Wider front view; thread cones on stand; machine head and table; power cable and pedal/foot control area on floor.

claims.evidence: No readable brand/model plate or label visible in the provided photos.
No readable country-of-origin marking visible in the photos.
Photos show the machine but do not show a running test (no video/indicator).

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Photos show some accessories/parts on the table, but no inventory list or clear proof that all accessories and the original manual are included.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history or inspection record shown; photos cannot confirm servicing status.

risks.risk: Model/brand mismatch: the seller’s stated EM 8500 may not match what’s pictured, which affects value and parts availability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the machine’s nameplate/serial/model label (front or side of head) and the motor label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic semi-industrial sewing machine with unknown model/parts risk.

risks.risk: Not actually working / intermittent faults (motor, timing, needle bar, feed, speed control). Photos can’t confirm performance.
risks.proof: Short video of a full test: power on, pedal run at low and high speed, and a straight stitch on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case for remote buying).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/manual or incomplete kit (presser feet, bobbins, needles, tools, belts, power cable, pedal).
risks.proof: Photo + count of every included item laid out on the floor/table, plus a clear photo of the manual cover.

risks.risk: Shipping/transport damage risk: machine appears set up in a room; internal damage may not show in photos.
risks.proof: Video showing the machine is stable and the head/stand are intact; also ask for whether it was recently moved and how it will be packed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher risk of transport-related issues.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the machine head nameplate/model/serial number (and motor label).
Video test: power on + pedal run (low/high) + stitching on fabric (show needle movement and feed).
Inventory photo: lay out all accessories and count them; include a clear photo of the manual cover/pages.
response.reason: The photos show a semi-industrial sewing machine setup, but the key details needed to price confidently (exact brand/model and proof it runs and is complete) are not readable or demonstrated.
